scope: Independent source-by-source visual audit of 13 assigned aggregate panoramas; no generation, promotion or original modification.
method: Original source cutouts and each full committed master were actually opened with view_image. All nine physical 750x1050 crops per target were then individually opened with view_image. Byte SHA-256 source and master matches bind observations to exact provenance assets; existing legacy passed flags were not accepted as anatomy evidence. Stylized shading differences alone do not trigger rejection. Uncertainty does not authorize promotion.

targets.scene_observations: Coherent meadow, river bend, mountains and blank research building; all six upper cards contain scenery only. Ground shadows fall right. All three subjects fit r3 cells, but one foreground leaf crosses Bulbasaur's left forefoot.

subjects.observations: Bulbasaur: bulb lobes, pointed ears, red eyes and forehead spots match the source. Source has three distinct white claws on each visible foot; generated main forefoot has two white round nails plus a skin-coloured point, and rear-foot white claws disappear into grass. Foreground leaf obscures the left forefoot boundary.

Charmander: blue eyes, two arms, three claws on both feet, cream belly and single flame-tail retained. Upper fangs are present on physical crop (not absent as preliminary full-view impression); the source's two lower white fangs are missing from the fully open generated mouth.

Squirtle: two red-brown eyes, cream segmented plastron, brown rear shell with pale rim, paired arms/legs and single curled blue tail retained. Three-point paw silhouettes are readable, and entire tail and feet remain inside the card.

targets.scene_observations: Continuous autumn valley, village, river and mountain scene; six upper crops contain no invented creatures. Bottom characters fully contained; Chikorita alone suffers foreground grass crossing body.

subjects.observations: Chikorita retains one head leaf, red eyes and rounded body. Source neck buds form distinct green nodules; generated foreground grass merges into a front neck bud and another blade crosses the face/body. Source rounded pale toenails are also lost on visible feet.

Cyndaquil retains closed eye, long snout, two small forearms, dark back and one back-flame cluster. Each source foot ends in a single broad pale nail; crop replaces these with three tiny claw/toe marks, an anatomical change.

Totodile retains open jaws, two upper fangs, lower teeth, yellow chest chevron and red dorsal/tail plates. Ground foot contains finer digit-like divisions than source, and raised hand ends have pale blobs absent from the blue jagged source hand. At this render resolution I cannot reliably separate intended fingers, highlights and grass from anatomical additions; do not approve anatomy without a clearer rerender.

targets.scene_observations: Open flower meadow, winding river and distant glass structure are coherent. All nine cards inspected; no additional creatures. Subjects stay inside bottom cells; dense grass compromises Chespin's feet.

subjects.observations: Chespin retains five head spikes and orange tail tip, but source's large white upper tooth is reduced to a tiny sliver and the left brown cheek patch disappears. Source feet end in two smooth pointed white claws; generated broad white feet are crossed by dense dark grass strokes, so claw count and boundaries are unreadable. The apparent many toes in full view are grass, not confirmed added anatomy.

Fennekin keeps both huge yellow/red ears, red eyes, white cheeks, black nose and red-tipped bushy tail. Front leg pose is changed; source has two separate thin rear legs beneath body, while crop resolves only one triangular rear-leg shape. Cannot confirm whether the second rear leg is legitimate occlusion or lost anatomy.

Froakie retains two raised yellow eyes, paired white nose bubbles, large white back/neck foam, bent blue hindlegs, a raised white hand and three-lobed ground hand. Visible finger silhouettes match source configuration; body remains separate from nearby flowers.

subjects.observations: Grookey keeps two head leaves with brown stick, round ears, yellow face mask, orange muzzle and hands, and curled brown tail. Scorbunny retains two orange-tipped long ears, yellow nose band, paired arms, orange eye irises and raised padded foot. Source has two orange neck/chest spots; artwork replaces them with a single dark neck line and omits both orange patches. Ground foot/toe separations are also compressed.

Sobble retains two-lobed yellow crest, blue cheek marks and coiled blue tail, but source has slender mitten-like hands curved inward beside bent knees. Generated forehands terminate in pale claw-like blocks on the ground and the bent-leg/hand silhouette is changed substantially. Plant crosses the tail and rear body.

targets.scene_observations: Crystal-studded meadow, terraces and river are coherent. All nine cards inspected; three chosen Mega forms remain inside bottom cells, but detail fidelity fails in every subject.

subjects.observations: Mega Mewtwo X retains pointed head projections, enlarged purple shoulder collar and purple belly/tail. Source open raised hand has three spherical finger pads; generated fist merges them into overlapping knuckles. Source feet have three broad rounded toes; generated feet have multiple small toe/claw ridges, partly buried in grass.

Mega Rayquaza retains long paired jaw horns, serpentine coil and luminous streamers, but source sharp teeth and distinct eye/jaw details are smeared into dark streaks. Source arm and three-clawed hand near upper neck are replaced by an indistinct green/yellow region; an extra foot-like projection appears at the lower-right coil. Orange body rings also lose their source ring structure.

Mega Latios source wing contains hollow white triangular marking. Crop turns it into a yellow iris with black pupil, inventing an eye on the wing. Source pointed head plumes become blunt uneven prongs; visible lower limb tip intersects a foreground blade. Purple wing/body silhouette otherwise identifies the Mega form.

targets.scene_observations: Stormy coastal inlet with rain, wet rocks and rough water is continuous across nine cards. Bottom middle cell is scenery-only as expected for two subjects. Both creatures fit their physical cells.

subjects.observations: Primal Kyogre retains four white flipper tips per side, blue body, pale circuit paths and two branched tail lobes. Source tail lobes have separated narrow finger-like branches; generated lobes fuse into flat sheets with light stripes. Source circular flipper emblems contain distinct inner spots, lost in solid generated discs.

Primal Groudon retains red/black armour, pale glowing patterns, tail fin and head crest, but source has three large toe claws per foot; generated left foot has four small claws.
